_doc: Latency hypothesis registry. Each entry is a candidate cost, not an accepted work item. The scout fan-out (workflow 'latency-scale-ledger') populates verdict/evidence/probe; a HUMAN moves an entry to accepted. No agent flips 'accepted' — that is the anti-runaway anchor, and it survives delegation because its purpose is that no agent ratifies its own findings.
_ladder: L0 CLAIMED -> L1 REPRODUCIBLE -> L2 ATTRIBUTED -> L3 BOUNDED -> L4 REDUCED -> L5 HELD. See SPEC.md.
_scale_axis: Every entry MUST state scale_behavior. A cost with no scale term has not reached L2.

ratchet._doc: The missing primitive. The 4x win from 98b556f has NOTHING pinning it - a refactor can silently give it back and no test fails. Floor must be read at merge-base so a branch cannot lower its own bar (same discipline as the suite ratchet).
